data.short_meaning: To be worshipped; worthy of adoration
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root ārādh, 'to worship, to propitiate' — 'worthy of worship'. Its root is Sanskrit ārādh (आराध्). A Sanskrit term for a deity worthy of worship. Aaradhya is a Sanskrit name meaning “To be worshipped; worthy of adoration”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aaradhya expresses “To be worshipped; worthy of adoration”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit root ārādh, 'to worship, to propitiate' — 'worthy of worship'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aaradhya total 32, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
